name: 03-recovery-department
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT PASSWORD RECOVERY: back 'Log in', heading 'Let’s get you back in.', small star holding a key. Short explanation, Email field labelled clearly, cobalt 'Send reset link', secondary 'Back to login'. Below subtle inline success message 'If an account exists for this email, a reset link is on its way.' Design success as same screen state. RIGHT INITIAL SETUP: back, slim 1-of-2 progress, title 'Find your corner of campus.', subtitle 'We’ll show you courses that fit.', Department dropdown set Computer Science, Year selector with Year 1 Year 2 Year 3 selected Year 4. Small line 'You can change this later.' Fixed bottom 'Choose my courses'. Use ordinary native-friendly selection controls with custom illustration limited to header.
